proof_body:
by
  intro α _ f hf
  refine ⟨MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.eapprox f, fun n x => (MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.eapprox_lt_top f n x).ne, fun n x => ?_, MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.tendsto_eapprox hf⟩
  exact MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.monotone_eapprox f (Nat.le_succ n) x
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [MeasurableSpace α] (f : α → ENNReal), Measurable f → ∃ φ : ℕ → MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc α ENNReal, (∀ n x, φ n x ≠ ⊤) ∧ (∀ n x, φ n x ≤ φ (n + 1) x) ∧ ∀ x, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => φ n x) Filter.atTop (nhds (f x))
